# GitHub Projects

This website contains assignments completed for the CSU 523C course requirements.

## Labs

- [Lab 1](lab-01.html)

    - In this lab USGS river gauge data along the Colorado River Basin, United States was compiled and 
      modeled.
    
- [Lab 2](lab-02.html)

    - This week's lab focused on displaying U.S. population data based on the proximity the cities are 
      to international and national borders.
    
- [Lab 3](lab-03.html)

    - This Lab focused on processing large-scale dam inventory data from across the United States. We 
      evaluated different tessellated surfaces to reveal how the data interpretation differed amongst         the methods.
      
- [Lab 4](lab-04.html)

    - In Lab 4 we analyzed flood data near Palo, Iowa using different data visualization methods.

- [Lab 5](lab-05.html) 

    - Lab 5 involved modeling streamflow data using differnt modeling methods and parameters from the         watersheds.

- [Lab 6](lab-06.html)

    - In this lab we evaluated and modeled streamflow along the Cache la Poudre River in northern 
      Colorado.
